title: Seven Psalms for a Hard Week
description: Seven of the most quietly honest psalms in scripture — for any week when you need words you don't have.

days.prompt: What 'how long, O Lord?' question would you put words to today?
Where have you felt forsaken? Speak it as the psalmist does — to God, not about him.
What would 'wait on the Lord' look like in the next 24 hours?
What thirst do you most need to name today?
What clean heart are you asking God to create in you?
Sit with the only psalm that doesn't end in hope. What does it tell you about prayer?
Where is your help coming from this week?
